goal: Implement the next step of the benchmark: build step 5, the bench harness that runs trials on generated devices

escalation.reason: A folder made from a slot's row has no evaluation token of its own. When no other trial of the suite has a token either, the password can't be proved, and the current code seals and deletes the run's plaintext under it, which a wrong password would make unrecoverable. 07-B6 says plaintext is never deleted under a seal the real password can't open, while 07-B7 says a run with no trial folder gets a seal made from the row. Reviewer's recommended ruling: stop the suite with nothing deleted. Five other Behaviour findings are for a fix round: a run's trial with its token missing is treated as nothing to check; a made folder isn't re-proved after a crash; a no-run folder can be sealed before the wrong password is noticed; a report's output check and write normalise the path differently; extraction's path check misses Windows forms; and read-back by name copies another suite's run with no password.
